amendment_gate_5._correction: CORRECTED AFTER THE SEALED NUMBERS WERE VISIBLE, and the correction is recorded rather than absorbed. The gate as first written compared the UNLEVERED book's terminal wealth to LEVERED SPY's -- an unlevered book against a levered benchmark, which is not 'at equal drawdown budget' and is the exact confusion this whole module exists to stop. Amendment 5 says 'sealed-era TW > levered-SPY TW at EQUAL drawdown budget', so both sides are sized to the budget: `largest_admissible.terminal_wealth` against `levered_spy_at_budget.terminal_wealth`. BOTH readings are reported. The correction changes ONE sub-condition and does NOT change the verdict -- the DSR and PBO conditions fail either way -- which is the only reason it was safe to make after the fact. The sealed era was NOT re-opened: every number here comes from the single opening already on the ledger.
